[[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Factions quest)]] (if Elementalist not primary profession) | profession = Elementalist | primary = y | secondary = n }} Having completed fundamental [[Elementalist]] training, meet with Master Togo for further instructions. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Elementalist | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Return to the monastery. * Seek out [[Master Togo]] in [[Linnok Courtyard]]. ===Reward=== * 600 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Open your world map (default: "M"), and click on [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into Linnok Courtyard. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Kai Ying :''"You performed well in the duel. I might go so far as to say you left your opponents "Obsidian Flamed" at their loss; they were shooting "Stone Daggers" from their eyes, did you notice?'' :'''''Master Togo''' wishes to meet with you in '''Linnok Courtyard'''.'' :''It is a long way back to the monastery, but you should be able to travel there easily enough using your map. Take care, friend."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'm on my way. | decline = I'd best learn more before I meet with him. | ask = You are ready to become an Elementalist, . Use your map to return to the monastery. '''Master Togo''' awaits you in '''Linnok Courtyard'''. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Master Togo :''"Headmaster Vhang has told me great thing about you, . You have begun to learn the way of the Elementalist, but to reach your full potential you must choose a second path.'' :''Speak with the other headmasters and learn what they have to teach you. When you are ready to make a final choice, come and speak to me again."'' {{sic}} ==Notes== *The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one player. Once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession, whatever that may be. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the quests given by the characters you are sent to in these quests, will put this in your quest log eventually. ==Trivia== *Kai Ying is punning again, this time on the skills [[Obsidian Flame]] and [[Stone Daggers]].
